title: Drummers Rag Baby Stevens and Spargo, and the Reliance Band break with Jack Lane
summary: Praise for two drummers, then Jack Lane booking jobs and putting his name on the Reliance Band, prompting the others to leave.

story.theme_name: Drummers and drumming: who played what, and how
story.community_name: Great drummers: who they admired and why
